name: Takiyo Mochizuki
source:
All great leaders require support, and with an abundance of color-coded folders and altruistic determination, Takiyo Mochizuki is the definition of a dependable assistant. Embodying a quiet strength beneath her reserved exterior, Takiyo handles her assigned tasks with flawless precision. She's frequently described by co-workers as someone well-liked and overly dedicated— and yet, despite this, remains consistently low-profile.

Oftentimes, Takiyo's anxious nature blockades her desire to help others. Suspiciously tied to a tragic accident, she found herself the victim of socialtical withdrawal; all the while, pursuing the goal to regain "control" of her life. Earnestly, Takiyo tries her best to live life facing forward, but like the most things, it's impossible to consistently turn a blind eye to the troublesome, encroaching past that looms so heavily.
